query: DELETE FROM analytics_fact_deltas d WHERE owner_id=$1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM analytics_normalized_facts n WHERE n.owner_id=d.owner_id AND n.fact_kind=d.fact_kind AND n.source=d.source AND n.fact_id=d.fact_id AND (n.occurred_at<$2 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM analytics_normalized_facts old WHERE old.owner_id=n.owner_id AND old.occurred_at<$2 AND ((old.fact_kind='request' AND n.request_source=old.source AND n.request_id=old.fact_id) OR (old.fact_kind='invocation' AND n.invocation_source=old.source AND n.invocation_id=old.fact_id)))))
